BiblicalUsage: Jischak is Isaac, the heir of Abraham. In Psalms 105:9, his oath unto Isaac. The fuller story is told on the Isaac profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Isaac matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
